This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Mando 1" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[near-human]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="Mando 1" /> was distinguished by scale-like patterns on their faces, including a v-shaped split on their foreheads.<ref name="Facebook" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Nevarro-F.png|right|200px|thumb|A member of this species ambushes Din Djarin]]
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|1}}</ref> at least two members of this species, one male and one female,<ref name="Facebook" /> could be found among the [[bounty hunter]]s on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]],<ref name="Mando 1" /> both taking part in the [[Incident on Nevarro|ambush]] of the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] during the [[hunt for Grogu]].<ref name="Mando 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Mando 1" /> They were designed by makeup artist [[Brian Sipe]], who unofficially nicknamed the male instance of the species "L'Amina Cutis" on set. The facial effects were initially created using generic scale texture prosthetic transfers from [[Legacy Effects]], alongside "Got Flesh" raised scar prosthetics.<ref name="Facebook" />

Once these prosthetics were applied, a skin tone color was used to tie it all together, and finally, "Illustrator DT Blush" was dry brushed over all of the scars and scales. Though Sipe performed the initial makeup test of the species, he could not recall who applied the various prosthetics during the actual shoots.<ref name="Facebook" />
